lesson.title: 指数函数的变换

en.title: Transformations of Exponential Functions
en.description: Apply parameter transformations, sketch exponential graphs, and model growth, decay and limiting levels.

lesson.description: 运用参数变换描绘指数图像，建立增长、衰减与极限值模型。

concepts.title: 参数与点的映射
concepts.summary:
对 $y=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$，先缩放或反射，再平移；通常 $c>0,c
e1,a
e0,b
e0$。

method.title: 步骤 1
method.body: 基图 $y=c^x$ 上的点 $(u,v)$ 变为 $(u/b+h,av+k)$。

method.title: 步骤 2
method.body: $|a|$ 为竖直伸缩因子，$a<0$ 关于 $x$ 轴反射；$1/|b|$ 为水平伸缩因子，$b<0$ 关于 $y$ 轴反射。

method.title: 步骤 3
method.body: $h$ 为向右的有向位移，$k$ 为向上的有向位移。若 $a=0$ 或 $b=0$，所得为常值函数，不能使用 $1/|b|$。

pitfalls: 先将指数完全因式分解；$2x-2=2(x-1)$。
水平伸缩因子是倒数；先反射/伸缩再平移。

en.title: Parameters and point mapping
en.summary:
For $y=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$, scale or reflect before translating; ordinarily $c>0,c
e1,a
e0,b
e0$.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: A base point $(u,v)$ on $y=c^x$ maps to $(u/b+h,av+k)$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: $|a|$ is the vertical scale factor; $a<0$ reflects in the $x$-axis. $1/|b|$ is the horizontal scale factor; $b<0$ reflects in the $y$-axis.

method.title: Step 3
method.body: $h$ is the signed rightward translation; $k$ is the signed upward translation. If $a=0$ or $b=0$, the result is constant and $1/|b|$ cannot be used.

pitfalls: The horizontal factor is reciprocal; reflect/scale before translating.

concepts.title: 图像、定义域与值域
concepts.summary: 非退化变换指数函数定义域为实数，水平渐近线为 $y=k$。

method.title: 步骤 1
method.body: 变换至少三个基图点，并画穿过这些点的平滑曲线。

method.title: 步骤 2
method.body: 若 $a>0$，值域为 $(k,\infty)$；若 $a<0$，值域为 $(-\infty,k)$。

method.title: 步骤 3
method.body: 代入 $x=0$ 得纵截距；令 $y=0$ 并检查正指数项是否可能满足。

pitfalls: 图像不接触渐近线；近似截距必须标明近似。

en.title: Sketches, domain and range
en.summary: A nonconstant transformed exponential has domain all real numbers and horizontal asymptote $y=k$.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Transform at least three base points and draw a smooth curve through them.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: For $a>0$ the range is $(k,\infty)$; for $a<0$ it is $(-\infty,k)$.

method.title: Step 3
method.body: Set $x=0$ for the vertical intercept; set $y=0$ and check whether a positive exponential can satisfy the equation.

pitfalls: The graph never meets its asymptote; label approximate intercepts as approximations.

concepts.title: 增长、衰减与时间尺度
concepts.summary: $Q(t)=A r^{t/d}+K$ 表示每 $d$ 个时间单位，离极限 $K$ 的差乘以 $r$。

method.title: 步骤 1
method.body: 确定初始时刻与单位，计算 $A=Q(0)-K$。

method.title: 步骤 3
method.body: 代入时间并按情境限制定义域；图解或数值求交点应明确为近似。

pitfalls: 冷却百分比作用于高于环境温度的温差。
连续模型的人口可取实数值，报告人数时再舍入。

en.title: Growth, decay and time scales
en.summary: $Q(t)=A r^{t/d}+K$ multiplies the difference from the limiting level $K$ by $r$ every $d$ time units.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Specify the initial time and units; compute $A=Q(0)-K$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: For $p\%$ growth use $r=1+p/100$; for $p\%$ decay use $r=1-p/100$; a half-life uses $r=1/2$.

method.title: Step 3
method.body: Substitute time and restrict the domain to the context; label graphical or numerical intersections as approximate.

pitfalls: A cooling percentage applies to the temperature difference above ambient.
A continuous population model takes real values; round only when reporting a count.

concepts.title: 截距与参数条件
concepts.summary: 对于非退化模型，纵截距为 $a c^{-bh}+k$；横截距要求 $-k/a>0$。

method.title: 步骤 1
method.body: 若 $a$ 与 $k$ 同号或 $k=0$，没有横截距。

method.title: 步骤 2
method.body: 若 $a,k$ 异号，方程 $c^{b(x-h)}=-k/a$ 有且仅有一个实解；可用图解求近似。

method.title: 步骤 3
method.body: 讨论参数影响时区分一般情况与特殊消去、常值退化情况。

pitfalls: 负号在指数外与指数内分别代表不同的反射。

en.title: Intercepts and parameter conditions
en.summary: For a nonconstant model, the vertical intercept is $a c^{-bh}+k$; a horizontal intercept requires $-k/a>0$.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: If $a$ and $k$ have the same sign, or $k=0$, there is no horizontal intercept.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: If $a,k$ have opposite signs, $c^{b(x-h)}=-k/a$ has exactly one real solution; a graph can give an approximation.

method.title: Step 3
method.body: Distinguish general parameter effects from special cancellation and constant degeneracies.

pitfalls: A minus outside the power and a minus in the exponent produce different reflections.

concepts.title: 从实际图拟合模型
concepts.summary: 给定渐近线与另一个图上点，可确定指数变换中的剩余参数；读图数值通常只是近似。

method.title: 步骤 1
method.body: 从顶点或渐近线确定 $h,k$ 中已知的量。

method.title: 步骤 2
method.body: 选择图上可辨认的点代入，说明该点是近似读数。

method.title: 步骤 3
method.body: 用数据趋势与情境检查模型；累计收入应趋于有限总额而不是后来下降。

pitfalls: 不能从低精度图断言唯一精确拟合。

en.title: Fit a model to graphical data
en.summary: An asymptote and another graphical point can determine the remaining parameter of a transformed exponential; graph readings are usually approximate.

method.title: Step 1
method.body: Use the vertex or asymptote to identify known values of $h,k$.

method.title: Step 2
method.body: Substitute an identifiable plotted point, explicitly stating that it is approximate.

method.title: Step 3
method.body: Check the trend against the context; cumulative revenue should approach a total rather than later decrease.

pitfalls: A low-resolution plot does not establish a unique exact fit.

questions.prompt: 以 $y=3^x$ 为基图，对 (a) $y=2(3)^{x-4}$；(b) $y=-\frac12(3)^{x/5}-5$，分别 (i) 写出参数并描述变换；(ii) 列表表示给定点在每次变换后的变化；(iii) 画基图及变换图；(iv) 描述定义域、值域、水平渐近线和截距的变化。给定基图点为 $(-1,1/3),(0,1),(1,3),(2,9),(3,27)$。

steps.title: a(i)：参数与变换
steps.body: $a=2,b=1,h=4,k=0$。先竖直拉伸2倍，再右移4；没有反射、水平伸缩或竖直平移。映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(u+4,2v)$。

steps.title: a(iii)：作图
steps.body: 在同一坐标系画给定基图点及变换后的五点。两曲线均递增并从上方趋近 $y=0$；变换曲线在 $(4,2)$ 通过。解析图显示两条真实指数曲线。

steps.title: a(iv)：特征与截距
steps.body: 定义域仍为 $\mathbb R$；值域仍为 $(0,\infty)$；渐近线仍为 $y=0$，仍无横截距。令 $x=0$ 得 $y=2(3)^{-4}=2/81\approx0.02469$，纵截距由1变为 $2/81$。

steps.title: b(i)：参数与变换
steps.body: $a=-1/2,b=1/5,h=0,k=-5$。水平拉伸5倍，竖直压缩到 $1/2$ 并关于 $x$ 轴反射，最后下移5。映射为 $(u,v)\mapsto(5u,-v/2-5)$。

steps.title: b(iii)：作图
steps.body: 标出最后一列的五点，画递减曲线；当 $x\to-\infty$ 时从下方趋近 $y=-5$。基图仍趋近 $y=0$；二者见解析图。

steps.title: b(iv)：特征与截距
steps.body: 定义域仍为 $\mathbb R$；值域变为 $(-\infty,-5)$；渐近线变为 $y=-5$。所有函数值都小于 $-5$，所以无横截距。$x=0$ 时 $y=-1/2-5=-11/2$，纵截距为 $(0,-11/2)$。

questions.answer: (a) $D=\mathbb R,R=(0,\infty)$，渐近线 $y=0$，纵截距 $2/81$；(b) $D=\mathbb R,R=(-\infty,-5)$，渐近线 $y=-5$，纵截距 $-11/2$。两者均无横截距。

en.prompt: Consider the base function $y=3^x$. For (a) $y=2(3)^{x-4}$ and (b) $y=-\frac12(3)^{x/5}-5$: (i) state the parameters and corresponding transformations; (ii) make a table showing the given points under each transformation; (iii) sketch the base and transformed graphs; (iv) describe the effects on domain, range, horizontal asymptote, and intercepts. The given base points are $(-1,1/3),(0,1),(1,3),(2,9),(3,27)$.

steps.title: a(i): Parameters and transformations
steps.body: $a=2,b=1,h=4,k=0$. Stretch vertically by 2, then translate right 4; no reflection, horizontal scale, or vertical translation. The map is $(u,v)\mapsto(u+4,2v)$.

steps.title: a(iii): Sketch
steps.body: Plot the given base points and the five transformed points on the same axes. Both curves increase and approach $y=0$ from above; the transformed curve passes through $(4,2)$. The solution image plots both exponential curves.

steps.title: a(iv): Features and intercepts
steps.body: The domain remains $\mathbb R$, range $(0,\infty)$, and asymptote $y=0$; there is still no horizontal intercept. At $x=0$, $y=2(3)^{-4}=2/81\approx0.02469$, so the vertical intercept changes from 1 to $2/81$.

steps.title: b(i): Parameters and transformations
steps.body: $a=-1/2,b=1/5,h=0,k=-5$. Stretch horizontally by 5, compress vertically by $1/2$ and reflect in the $x$-axis, then translate down 5. The map is $(u,v)\mapsto(5u,-v/2-5)$.

steps.title: b(iii): Sketch
steps.body: Plot the five final points and draw a decreasing curve. As $x\to-\infty$, it approaches $y=-5$ from below. The base curve still approaches $y=0$; both appear in the solution plot.

steps.title: b(iv): Features and intercepts
steps.body: The domain remains $\mathbb R$; the range becomes $(-\infty,-5)$ and asymptote $y=-5$. All values are below $-5$, so no horizontal intercept exists. At $x=0$, $y=-1/2-5=-11/2$, giving vertical intercept $(0,-11/2)$.

en.answer: (a) $D=\mathbb R,R=(0,\infty)$, asymptote $y=0$, vertical intercept $2/81$; (b) $D=\mathbb R,R=(-\infty,-5)$, asymptote $y=-5$, vertical intercept $-11/2$. Neither has a horizontal intercept.
en.label: Textbook Example 1

questions.label: 教材例题 1

questions.prompt: 一杯水加热到 $100^\circ\mathrm C$，然后在室温 $20^\circ\mathrm C$ 的房间冷却。每分钟记录温度 $T$ 随时间 $m$（分钟）的变化；题述水温每5分钟按指数规律减少25%，所得图像如下。(a) 写出形如 $y=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$ 的模型。(b) 解释每个参数与已知信息的关系。

steps.title: a：确定衰减量与基数
steps.body: 图像趋近室温20而不是0，因此25%衰减应理解为温差 $T-20$ 每5分钟减少25%。每段剩余因子为 $1-0.25=3/4$；经过 $m$ 分钟有 $m/5$ 段。

steps.title: b：解释全部参数
steps.body: 以 $c=3/4$ 为底：$a=80$ 是初始温差；$b=1/5$ 把分钟换成5分钟段数，水平拉伸5倍；$h=0$ 是冷却起始时刻；$k=20$ 为室温，对应上移20与渐近线 $T=20$。

en.prompt: A cup of water is heated to $100^\circ\mathrm C$ and allowed to cool in a room at $20^\circ\mathrm C$. Temperature $T$ is measured every minute against time $m$ in minutes; the stated exponential decrease is 25% every 5 min, giving the graph shown. (a) Find the transformed function in the form $y=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$. (b) Relate each parameter to the information provided.

steps.title: a: Identify the decaying quantity and base
steps.body: The graph approaches room temperature 20 rather than 0, so the 25% decay applies to the excess temperature $T-20$ every 5 min. The remaining factor is $1-0.25=3/4$, and $m$ minutes contain $m/5$ intervals.

steps.title: a: Check an actual time
steps.body: $T(20)=80(3/4)^4+20=80(81/256)+20=45.3125^\circ\mathrm C$, agreeing with the plotted value near 45. Physically $m\ge0$, so $20<T\le100$.

steps.title: b: Interpret every parameter
steps.body: With base $c=3/4$: $a=80$ is the initial temperature excess; $b=1/5$ converts minutes to 5-minute intervals, a horizontal stretch by 5; $h=0$ is the start of cooling; $k=20$ is room temperature, corresponding to an upward translation by 20 and asymptote $T=20$.

en.label: Textbook Example 2

questions.label: 教材例题 2

questions.prompt: (a) 在各自同一坐标系画图：A组 (i) $f(x)=3^x$，(ii) $f(x)=3^x+2$，(iii) $f(x)=3^x-4$；B组 (i) $f(x)=2^x$，(ii) $f(x)=2^{x-3}$，(iii) $f(x)=2^{x+1}$。(b) 比较A组，对任意常数 $k$ 描述 $3^x$ 与 $3^x+k$ 的关系。(c) 比较B组，对任意常数 $h$ 描述 $2^x$ 与 $2^{x-h}$ 的关系。

steps.title: b：竖直比较
steps.body: 加 $k$ 将每个纵坐标增加 $k$，所以向上平移 $k$ 个单位；$k<0$ 时向下 $|k|$。

steps.title: c：水平比较
steps.body: 令新指数 $x-h=u$ 得 $x=u+h$，所以向右平移 $h$ 个单位；$h<0$ 时向左 $|h|$。

questions.answer: A组为竖直平移，B组为水平平移；具体曲线见解析图。

en.prompt: (a) Graph each set on one set of axes: Set A (i) $f(x)=3^x$, (ii) $f(x)=3^x+2$, (iii) $f(x)=3^x-4$; Set B (i) $f(x)=2^x$, (ii) $f(x)=2^{x-3}$, (iii) $f(x)=2^{x+1}$. (b) Compare Set A and describe the relationship between $3^x$ and $3^x+k$ for any constant $k$. (c) Compare Set B and describe the relationship between $2^x$ and $2^{x-h}$ for any constant $h$.

steps.title: a: Set A point tables
steps.body: At $x=-1,0,1$, the ordinates are $1/3,1,3$ for A(i), $7/3,3,5$ for A(ii), and $-11/3,-3,-1$ for A(iii). Draw smooth exponential curves; the asymptotes are $y=0,2,-4$, respectively.

steps.title: a: Set B point tables
steps.body: From the points $(-1,1/2),(0,1),(1,2)$ on $2^x$, the corresponding points of B(ii) are $(2,1/2),(3,1),(4,2)$; those of B(iii) are $(-2,1/2),(-1,1),(0,2)$. All three asymptotes are $y=0$.

steps.title: b: Vertical comparison
steps.body: Adding $k$ adds $k$ to each ordinate: translate up $k$ units, or down $|k|$ when $k<0$.

steps.title: c: Horizontal comparison
steps.body: Setting the new exponent $x-h=u$ gives $x=u+h$: translate right $h$ units, or left $|h|$ when $h<0$.

en.answer: Set A uses vertical translations and Set B horizontal translations; the solution plot shows all six curves.
en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: 描述 $f(x)=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$ 中参数 $h,k$ 的作用。

steps.title: 水平位置
steps.body: 在伸缩和反射之后，$h$ 把点 $(u,v)$ 的横坐标加 $h$：$h>0$ 向右，$h<0$ 向左。

steps.title: 竖直位置
steps.body: $k$ 把纵坐标加 $k$，所以 $k>0$ 向上、$k<0$ 向下；非退化图像的渐近线变为 $y=k$。

questions.answer: $h$ 控制水平平移，$k$ 控制竖直平移。

en.prompt: Describe the roles of $h$ and $k$ in $f(x)=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$.

steps.title: Horizontal location
steps.body: After scales and reflections, $h$ adds $h$ to the horizontal coordinate: right when $h>0$, left when $h<0$.

steps.title: Vertical location
steps.body: $k$ adds $k$ to the ordinate: up when $k>0$, down when $k<0$; the nonconstant graph has asymptote $y=k$.

en.answer: $h$ controls horizontal translation; $k$ controls vertical translation.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 2

questions.label: 反思与回应 2

steps.title: b：一般竖直因子
steps.body: $a$ 将纵坐标乘 $a$：$|a|>1$ 拉伸，$0<|a|<1$ 压缩，$a<0$ 还关于 $x$ 轴反射。$a=0$ 时成为直线 $y=0$。

steps.title: c：一般水平因子
steps.body: $b\ne0$ 时横坐标除以 $b$，水平因子为 $1/|b|$，$b<0$ 时再关于 $y$ 轴反射。$b=0$ 时 $2^{0x}=1$，成为常值函数。

questions.answer: C组改变高度及上下方向；D组改变水平尺度及左右方向。零参数产生常值函数。

en.prompt: (a) Graph each set on one set of axes. Set C: (i) $(1/2)^x$, (ii) $3(1/2)^x$, (iii) $(3/4)(1/2)^x$, (iv) $-4(1/2)^x$, (v) $-(1/3)(1/2)^x$. Set D: (i) $2^x$, (ii) $2^{3x}$, (iii) $2^{x/3}$, (iv) $2^{-2x}$, (v) $2^{-2x/3}$. (b) For any real $a$, compare $(1/2)^x$ and $a(1/2)^x$. (c) For any real $b$, compare $2^x$ and $2^{bx}$.

steps.title: a: Specific Set C points
steps.body: At abscissas $-1,0,1$, the five ordinate triples are (i) $2,1,1/2$; (ii) $6,3,3/2$; (iii) $3/2,3/4,3/8$; (iv) $-8,-4,-2$; (v) $-2/3,-1/3,-1/6$. Each approaches $y=0$.

steps.title: a: Specific Set D points
steps.body: From $(-1,1/2),(0,1),(1,2)$, the five abscissa triples become (i) $-1,0,1$; (ii) $-1/3,0,1/3$; (iii) $-3,0,3$; (iv) $1/2,0,-1/2$; (v) $3/2,0,-3/2$, with ordinates unchanged.

steps.title: b: General vertical factor
steps.body: $a$ multiplies ordinates by $a$: stretch when $|a|>1$, compress when $0<|a|<1$, and additionally reflect in the $x$-axis when $a<0$. If $a=0$, the graph is the line $y=0$.

steps.title: c: General horizontal factor
steps.body: For $b\ne0$, divide abscissas by $b$: the horizontal factor is $1/|b|$, with a reflection in the $y$-axis when $b<0$. If $b=0$, $2^{0x}=1$ is constant.

en.answer: Set C changes height and vertical orientation; Set D changes horizontal scale and orientation. A zero parameter gives a constant function.
en.label: Investigate 3

questions.label: 探究 3

questions.prompt: 负号对图像有什么影响？（参照探究D组的负指数系数。）

steps.title: 比较对应点
steps.body: $2^{bx}$ 中 $b<0$ 把 $x=u$ 变为 $x=u/b$；符号改变横坐标方向。例如 $2^{-2x}$ 把 $(1,2)$ 映为 $(-1/2,2)$。这是关于 $y$ 轴反射，同时水平压缩到 $1/2$。

questions.answer: 指数内的负系数产生关于y轴的反射。

en.prompt: What effect does the negative sign have on the graph? (Refer to the negative exponent coefficients in Set D.)

steps.title: Compare corresponding points
steps.body: When $b<0$ in $2^{bx}$, $x=u$ becomes $x=u/b$, reversing horizontal direction. For example, $2^{-2x}$ maps $(1,2)$ to $(-1/2,2)$: reflect in the $y$-axis and compress horizontally by $1/2$.

en.answer: A negative coefficient inside the exponent produces a reflection in the y-axis.
en.label: Sidebar: The negative sign

questions.label: 旁注：负号的影响

questions.prompt: 描述 $f(x)=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$ 中参数 $a,b$ 的作用。

steps.title: 参数a
steps.body: $a$ 使相对平移前 $x$ 轴的纵坐标乘 $a$；竖直尺度为 $|a|$，$a<0$ 时关于 $x$ 轴反射，随后再加 $k$。

steps.title: 参数b与例外
steps.body: $b\ne0$ 时水平尺度为 $1/|b|$，$b<0$ 时关于 $y$ 轴反射，随后再加 $h$。$a=0$ 给出 $y=k$；$b=0$ 给出 $y=a+k$。

en.prompt: Describe the roles of $a,b$ in $f(x)=a(c)^{b(x-h)}+k$.

steps.title: Parameter a
steps.body: $a$ multiplies ordinates relative to the pre-translation $x$-axis by $a$: vertical factor $|a|$, with reflection in the $x$-axis if $a<0$, followed by adding $k$.

steps.title: Parameter b and exceptions
steps.body: For $b\ne0$, the horizontal scale is $1/|b|$, with reflection in the $y$-axis if $b<0$, followed by adding $h$. If $a=0$, $y=k$; if $b=0$, $y=a+k$.

en.answer: The full point mapping is $(u,v)\mapsto(u/b+h,av+k)$ for $b\ne0$.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 4

questions.label: 反思与回应 4

questions.prompt: 这与以前学习的函数变换顺序有什么相同之处？

steps.title: 核对顺序
steps.body: 与其他函数相同：先完成伸缩/反射，再平移。若 $b=-2,h=-5$，正确横坐标是 $-u/2-5$；先左移5再反射压缩则变为 $-(u-5)/2=-u/2+5/2$，不相同。

questions.answer: 先伸缩和反射，再平移；a与b的变换可交换。

en.prompt: How does this compare to your past experience with transformations?

steps.title: Check the order
steps.body: As with other functions, complete scales/reflections before translations. For $b=-2,h=-5$, the correct abscissa is $-u/2-5$. Translating left 5 first and then reflecting/compressing instead gives $-(u-5)/2=-u/2+5/2$, which differs.

en.answer: Scale and reflect before translating; the a and b transformations may be interchanged.

steps.title: 水平渐近线的含义
steps.body: 累计票房趋于某个总收入：随着放映结束，每周新增收入趋近0。Titanic也预期会趋于有限总额。这是对给定历史图的模型解释，不是当前票房数据调查。

steps.title: 二次模型：一个可复现的示例
steps.body: 顶点给出 $h=22,k=573$。从图近似取Titanic点 $(2,100)$：$100=a(2-22)^2+573$，故 $400a=-473$、$a\approx-473/400=-1.1825$。一个可能模型为 $y\approx-1.1825(x-22)^2+573$，用于图中约2至22周这一段。图上读点可略有不同，因此不是唯一精确模型。

steps.title: 指数模型：由渐近线与图点定参数
比较与适用区间
steps.body: 两模型都能在有限后期区间拟合。对长期累计收入，指数模型更合理：递增且趋近600。二次模型在22周后下降，会表示累计票房减少；其早期区间外甚至可能为负。指数拟合也只应在数据支持区间使用，不能把外推当作真实收入。

questions.answer: 渐近线表示最终累计收入。可选模型为 $y\approx-1.1825(x-22)^2+573$ 与 $y\approx-35(0.65)^{0.3(x-20)}+600$；后者更符合长期趋于总额的情境。图上读数造成合理的模型差异。

en.prompt: Work with a partner on the given movie box-office graph. Let $x$ be weeks and $y$ cumulative revenue in millions of dollars. (1) Avatar and Dark Knight appear to have horizontal asymptotes. Interpret this and decide whether Titanic will eventually show the same feature. (2) For Titanic: (a) with vertex $(22,573)$, find a possible quadratic $y=a(x-h)^2+k$ for this part of the curve; (b) assuming asymptote $y=600$, find a possible exponential $y=-35(0.65)^{0.3(x-h)}+k$; (c) decide which type better models the curve and explain.

steps.title: Meaning of the horizontal asymptote
steps.body: Cumulative revenue approaches a final total as weekly new receipts approach zero near the end of the run. Titanic is also expected to approach a finite total. This interprets the supplied historical graph rather than conducting a current revenue survey.

steps.title: Quadratic: one reproducible example
steps.body: The vertex gives $h=22,k=573$. Read the approximate Titanic point $(2,100)$: $100=a(2-22)^2+573$, so $400a=-473$ and $a\approx-473/400=-1.1825$. One possible model is $y\approx-1.1825(x-22)^2+573$, for the plotted portion from roughly week 2 to week 22. Different reasonable graph readings give slightly different models; this is not a unique exact fit.

steps.title: Exponential: use the asymptote and a plotted point
steps.body: The asymptote gives $k=600$. Read the approximate point $(20,565)$ and substitute: $565=-35(0.65)^{0.3(20-h)}+600$. Thus $(0.65)^{0.3(20-h)}=1$, so $0.3(20-h)=0$ and $h\approx20$. The model is $y\approx-35(0.65)^{0.3(x-20)}+600$. It predicts $572.97$ at week 22, agreeing with the plotted 573.

steps.title: Comparison and applicable interval
steps.body: Both can fit a limited late-time interval. The exponential is more reasonable for long-term cumulative revenue because it increases toward 600. The quadratic decreases after week 22, implying falling cumulative receipts, and can even be negative outside its early fitted interval. The exponential fit should also be used only where the data support it, not treated as observed revenue outside that interval.

en.answer: An asymptote represents final cumulative revenue. Possible models are $y\approx-1.1825(x-22)^2+573$ and $y\approx-35(0.65)^{0.3(x-20)}+600$; the latter better represents a long-term limiting total. Reasonable graph-reading differences give different fits.

steps.title: b: Plotting points and physical interval

(b) Graph the function and use it to estimate the age of an organism with 20% of its original C-14 remaining.

steps.title: b: Locate the 20% intersection

en.prompt: On Monday morning Julia finds a bacteria colony covering $100\,\mathrm{cm}^2$ of agar; after 10 h it covers $200\,\mathrm{cm}^2$. Assume exponential growth. steps.body: The area doubles every 10 h. With $t$ hours since Monday morning, $A(t)=100(2)^{t/10}$. Then $A(24)=100(2)^{2.4}\approx527.80316\,\mathrm{cm}^2$, about 528 square centimetres.

steps.title: b: Use consistent area units

exercises.prompt: 15年前，国家公园有325只狐狸；现在有650只。假定经历指数增长。(a) 预测20年后的数量；(b) 举出一种使增长低于指数速度的因素。指数增长对种群是否健康？说明理由。

steps.title: b：资源与健康
steps.body: 示例：猎物和栖息地有限，数量增加后每只狐狸能获得的食物减少，出生率可能下降或死亡率上升。短期增长可反映恢复，但长期无止境的指数增长不可持续，可能导致资源耗尽、疾病和种群骤减；因此不能仅由指数增长判断健康。

exercises.answer: (a) 约1638只；(b) 食物/栖息地限制是一个合理因素，长期无限指数增长不可持续。

en.prompt: Fifteen years ago a national park had 325 foxes; today it has 650. Assume exponential growth. (a) Project the population in 20 years. (b) Give one factor that could slow growth to less than exponential. Is exponential growth healthy for a population? Explain.

steps.title: a: Measure time from today
steps.body: The population doubles from 325 to 650 in 15 years. With $t=0$ today, $F(t)=650(2)^{t/15}$; check $F(-15)=325$. In 20 years, $F(20)=650(2)^{4/3}\approx1637.89736$, about 1638 foxes.

steps.title: b: Resources and population health
steps.body: One example is limited prey and habitat: as numbers rise, food per fox decreases, possibly reducing births or increasing mortality. Short-term growth may indicate recovery, but indefinite exponential growth is unsustainable and may cause resource depletion, disease, and a population crash. Exponential growth alone therefore does not establish population health.

en.answer: (a) About 1638 foxes; (b) limited food or habitat is a possible limiting factor, and indefinite exponential growth is unsustainable.

exercises.prompt: 形如 $y=c^x$ 的指数函数图像没有 $x$ 轴截距。用自己的例子解释原因。

steps.title: 指数值严格为正
steps.body: 对于合法底数 $c>0$ 和任意实数 $x$，$c^x>0$，所以不能等于0。例取 $y=2^x$，在 $x=-2,-1,0,1$ 时值为 $1/4,1/2,1,2$；向左虽趋近0，但任何有限实数处都不等于0。

steps.title: 非恒定条件与底数1例外
steps.body: 若 $c>0,c\ne1$，$c^x$ 在一端趋近0，所以 $y=0$ 是水平渐近线。若 $c=1$，则 $y=1^x=1$ 是常函数，仍无 $x$ 轴截距，但不趋近0，$y=0$ 不是其渐近线。

exercises.answer: 对所有 $c>0$，$c^x>0$，所以没有 $x$ 轴截距。仅当 $c\ne1$ 时，$y=0$ 是水平渐近线；$c=1$ 时图像是直线 $y=1$。

en.prompt: The graph of an exponential function $y=c^x$ has no $x$-intercept. Explain why using an example of your own.

steps.title: Exponential values are strictly positive
steps.body: For a valid base $c>0$ and any real $x$, $c^x>0$, so it cannot equal 0. For example, $y=2^x$ has values $1/4,1/2,1,2$ at $x=-2,-1,0,1$. It approaches 0 to the left but is never 0 at a finite real input.

steps.title: Nonconstant condition and the base-1 exception
steps.body: For $c>0,c\ne1$, $c^x$ approaches 0 at one end, so $y=0$ is a horizontal asymptote. If $c=1$, then $y=1^x=1$ is constant: it still has no $x$-intercept, but does not approach 0, so $y=0$ is not an asymptote.

en.answer: For every $c>0$, $c^x>0$, so there is no $x$-intercept. The line $y=0$ is a horizontal asymptote only when $c\ne1$; for $c=1$, the graph is the line $y=1$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 指数函数的哪些参数影响图像的 $x$ 轴截距？解释。(b) 哪些参数影响 $y$ 轴截距？解释。

steps.title: a：横截距的存在
steps.body: 固定 $c>0,c\ne1$，先考虑 $a,b\ne0$。令 $0=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$，得 $c^{b(x-h)}=-k/a$。右边必须正，即 $a,k$ 异号；若 $k=0$ 或二者同号，就没有横截距。因此 $a,k$ 决定截距是否存在。

steps.title: a：横截距的位置
steps.body: 若截距存在，令 $c^u=-k/a$，则 $b(x-h)=u$、$x=h+u/b$。所以 $a,b,h,k$ 一般都能影响位置。例如 $2^x-2$ 的截距为1；改 $a=2$ 得 $2(2)^x-2$ 的截距0；改 $b=2$ 得 $2^{2x}-2$ 的截距 $1/2$；右移1得2；改 $k=-4$ 也得2。特殊情况 $-k/a=1$ 时 $u=0$，截距恰为 $h$，不随非零 $b$ 改变。

steps.title: b：纵截距公式与例外
steps.body: 代入 $x=0$，纵截距为 $a c^{-bh}+k$，所以四个参数一般都能影响它。若 $h=0$，则纵截距为 $a+k$，与 $b$ 无关；$h$ 的影响也需要 $b\ne0$。例如固定 $a=1,c=2,k=0$，当 $(b,h)=(1,1),(2,1),(1,2)$ 时纵截距分别为 $1/2,1/4,1/4$。

steps.title: 退化常值情况
steps.body: 若允许 $a=0$，函数为 $y=k$；若允许 $b=0$，函数为 $y=a+k$。常值为0时每个实数 $x$ 都是零点；否则无横截距。上述非退化指数图的唯一横截距结论不适用于这些常值情况。

exercises.answer: 一般四个参数 $a,b,h,k$ 均可影响两类截距；横截距需 $-k/a>0$，纵截距为 $a c^{-bh}+k$，并须考虑上述特殊情况。

en.prompt: (a) Which parameters of an exponential function affect the $x$-intercept? Explain. (b) Which parameters affect the $y$-intercept? Explain.

steps.title: a: Existence of a horizontal intercept
steps.body: Fix $c>0,c\ne1$ and first assume $a,b\ne0$. Setting $0=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$ gives $c^{b(x-h)}=-k/a$. The right side must be positive, so $a,k$ must have opposite signs; if $k=0$ or their signs agree, no horizontal intercept exists. Thus $a,k$ control its existence.

steps.title: a: Location of the horizontal intercept
steps.body: When an intercept exists, let $c^u=-k/a$. Then $b(x-h)=u$ and $x=h+u/b$, so $a,b,h,k$ can generally all affect its location. For example, $2^x-2$ has intercept 1; setting $a=2$ gives intercept 0 for $2(2)^x-2$; setting $b=2$ gives $1/2$ for $2^{2x}-2$; translating right 1 gives 2; setting $k=-4$ also gives 2. In the special case $-k/a=1$, $u=0$ and the intercept is $h$, independent of nonzero $b$.

steps.title: b: Vertical-intercept formula and special cases
steps.body: At $x=0$ the vertical intercept is $a c^{-bh}+k$, so all four parameters can generally affect it. If $h=0$, the intercept is $a+k$, independent of $b$; dependence on $h$ also requires $b\ne0$. For example, with $a=1,c=2,k=0$, the choices $(b,h)=(1,1),(2,1),(1,2)$ give vertical intercepts $1/2,1/4,1/4$.

steps.title: Degenerate constant cases
steps.body: If $a=0$ is allowed, the function is $y=k$; if $b=0$, it is $y=a+k$. When the constant is 0, every real input is a zero; otherwise there is no horizontal intercept. The unique-intercept conclusion for nonconstant exponentials does not apply to these cases.

en.answer: In general all four parameters $a,b,h,k$ can affect either intercept. A horizontal intercept requires $-k/a>0$; the vertical intercept is $a c^{-bh}+k$, with the special cases stated above.
